channel.title: Metriq Updates
channel.description: Latest news and product updates from Metriq.

item.title: Data from new IBM and OriginQ devices
item.description: IBM's ibm_miami and OriginQ's WK_C180 have been added to the dataset, with more devices on the way. Check back often for updates!

item.title: Rigetti Ankaa-3 retired
item.description:
Rigetti retired Ankaa-3 on April 17, 2026. Historical benchmark results remain available in Metriq under “Show retired devices”.
View announcement: https://rigetti.statuspage.io/incidents/dbsh9sb7wt1k

item.title: IBM and OriginQ retired devices
item.description: IBM's ibm_brisbane and OriginQ's wukong_72 and wukong_102 have now been retired by the vendors. Historical results remain available in Metriq for reference.

item.title: The Metriq paper is on arXiv! 🗞️
item.description:
Metriq: A Collaborative Platform for Benchmarking Quantum Computers is now available on arXiv.
Read the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08680

item.title: metriq-gym 0.7.0 released
item.description:
New version of metriq-gym now available with improvements to CLOPS and EPLG, and more support for Quantinuum devices.
View changelog: https://github.com/unitaryfoundation/metriq-gym/releases/tag/v0.7.0

item.title: More data sources
item.description: New devices and fresh benchmark runs were added to the dataset. Check back often as coverage expands.

item.title: Platforms view now default
item.description: The app now opens on Platforms by default, with score bars for quick comparison.
